raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation - Though DFlash now supports DPA mode, SGLang runs in eager mode, resulting launch overhead. - Update DFlash draft & verify batch planning to capture graphs and replay them in both active and idle ranks. Logs: ``` [2026-10-26 07:16:57 DP0 TP0 EP0] Capture target verify CUDA graph end. bs=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8], elapsed=3.74 s, mem usage=0.30 GB, avail mem=34.42 GB. [2026-10-26 07:16:57 DP0 TP0 EP0] Disable DFLASH draft cuda graph because dp attention is enabled (draft runs eager). [2026-10-26 07:18:18 DP0 TP0 EP0] Prefill batch, #new-seq: 1, #new-token: 95, #cached-token: 0, full token usage: 0.00, mamba usage: 0.10, #running-req: 0, #queue-req: 0, #pending-token: 0, cuda graph: True, input throughput (token/s): 1.32 [2026-10-26 07:18:22 DP0 TP0 EP0] Decode batch, #running-req: 1, #full token: 222, full token usage: 0.00, mamba num: 4, mamba usage: 0.10, accept len: 3.12, accept rate: 0.30, cuda graph: False, gen throughput (token/s): 1.48, #queue-req: 0 ``` ## Modifications 1. Allow draft workers to initialize CUDA Graph when DPA is enabled. This lets `batch.can_run_decode_cuda_graph=True`. 2. Make DFlash draft workers produce their drafts **locally** to avoid cross-DP collective collision. 3. Allow idle target worker to replay its graph. 4. Align idle target worker's custom masks. ## Accuracy Tests ```bash sgl-eval run gsm8k \ --from-dataset /tmp/gsm8k-local-data-20261027-105323/test.jsonl \ --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 \ --model qwen3.8-27b \ --num-examples 200 \ --num-threads 16 \ --n-repeats 1 \ --max-tokens 8192 \ --temperature 1.0 \ --top-p 0.95 \ --thinking \ --chat-template-kwarg enable_thinking=true \ --seed 0 \ --out-dir /tmp/dflash-pr-accuracy-local-20261027-105342 ``` ``` == gsm8k == 200 examples (single-shot) | 61.1s | 1355 tok/s | 83K tokens * score = 97.00% stop_rate = 99.50% truncated_rate = 0.50% error_rate = 0.00% avg_input_tokens = 136.3 tokens avg_output_tokens = 413.7 tokens avg_thinking_tokens = 404.8 tokens Metrics: /tmp/dflash-pr-accuracy-local-20261027-105342/sgl_eval_gsm8k_20261027-105343/metrics.json Predictions: /tmp/dflash-pr-accuracy-local-20261027-105342/sgl_eval_gsm8k_20261027-105343 (1 jsonl file(s)) ``` ## Speed Tests and Profiling ### Hardware specs - Hardware: 4xH100 80GB HBM3 - Launch command: ```bash sglang serve \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 8080 \ --trust-remote-code \ --model-path "/models/Qwen3.8-27B" \ --enable-metrics \ --served-model-name "qwen3.8-27b" \ --tp-size 4 \ --ep-size 4 \ --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \ --mem-fraction-static 0.50 \ --attention-backend flashinfer \ --reasoning-parser qwen3 \ --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \ --speculative-algorithm DFLASH \ --speculative-draft-model-path "/models/incoai-Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2" \ --speculative-num-draft-tokens 8 \ --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer \ --mamba-ssm-dtype float32 \ --attn-dp-size 2 \ --enable-dp-lm-head \ --enable-dp-attention-local-control-broadcast ``` ### Torch profiling: #### Original ##### Active Rank ##### Idle Rank #### Modified ##### Active Rank ##### Idle Rank ### Benchmark ```bash HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \ python -m sglang.benchmark.serving \ --backend sglang \ --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8080 \ --model /models/Qwen3.8-27B \ --served-model-name qwen3.8-27b \ --tokenizer /models/Qwen3.8-27B \ --dataset-name sharegpt \ --dataset-path /datasets/sharegpt/ShareGPT_V3_unfiltered_cleaned_split.json \ --num-prompts 200 \ --sharegpt-context-len 8192 \ --apply-chat-template \ --seed 42 \ --temperature 0 \ --request-rate inf \
